verdict.rationale: Retell's docs describe a per-agent data retention period. Once it expires, call and chat data (transcripts, recordings, logs) for that agent is automatically and permanently deleted, which covers the core of controlling retention and deletion. The only evidence is one first-party docs page, and the deletion described is automatic and time-based only. missing for 10: on-demand deletion of individual calls or chats via API or dashboard, account-wide or default retention settings, independent or hands-on corroboration.
